name: ModelVariant170_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant170_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (three white flashes frame the effect while a glow gathers at one of this slot's parts and trails sparkles back to it, then a beam of rings and a band of shaded rings reach out to the other slot, where sixty sparks burst one after another); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the glow, trail and rings, packs three texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the trail has returned, 4 while the sparks burst, 1 once after them, 0 during the closing flash and 2 at the end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-187 and 317 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
